# Get sent transactions for this month (May 2023)
transactions = []
page = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_login['access_token'],
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if 'message' in resp:
        print("Error:", resp)
        break
    if not resp:
        break
    transactions.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

print("Number of sent transactions this month:", len(transactions))
for t in transactions:
    print(t['transaction_id'], t['receiver']['email'], t['amount'])
